SELECT work_mode AS work_mode, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM analytics.attendance_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND status_kehadiran = 'HADIR' GROUP BY work_mode ORDER BY count DESC 
 LIMIT 100;

queryComparisons.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(present_days) / NULLIF(SUM(expected_days), 0) AS attendance_rate 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(present_days) / NULLIF(SUM(expected_days), 0) AS attendance_rate 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE nama_departemen IN ('Badan Pendapatan Daerah Provinsi Jawa Timur') AND tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT nama_departemen AS nama_departemen, 100.0 * SUM(present_days) / NULLIF(SUM(expected_days), 0) AS attendance_rate 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY nama_departemen ORDER BY attendance_rate ASC 
 LIMIT 1000;

Sort Key: (((100.0 * sum((sum(CASE WHEN (f.is_expected_workday AND ((f.status_kehadiran)::text = 'HADIR'::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)))) / NULLIF(sum((sum(CASE WHEN f.is_expected_workday THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))), '0'::numeric)))

queryComparisons.sql:
SELECT nama_departemen AS nama_departemen, 100.0 * SUM(present_days) / NULLIF(SUM(expected_days), 0) AS attendance_rate, 100.0 * SUM(ontime_days) / NULLIF(SUM(evaluated_days), 0) AS ontime_rate, 100.0 * SUM(absent_days) / NULLIF(SUM(expected_days), 0) AS absence_rate, 1.0 * SUM(late_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(late_days), 0) AS average_lateness 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY nama_departemen ORDER BY attendance_rate DESC 
 LIMIT 1000;

Sort Key: (((100.0 * sum((sum(CASE WHEN (f.is_expected_workday AND ((f.status_kehadiran)::text = 'HADIR'::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)))) / NULLIF(sum((sum(CASE WHEN f.is_expected_workday THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))), '0'::numeric))) DESC

queryComparisons.sql:
SELECT CASE lateness_bucket WHEN '<1' THEN '01 · <1 menit' WHEN '1-15' THEN '02 · 1–15 menit' WHEN '16-30' THEN '03 · 16–30 menit' WHEN '31-60' THEN '04 · 31–60 menit' WHEN '>60' THEN '05 · >60 menit' END AS "Rentang keterlambatan", SUM(late_days) AS "Pegawai-hari terlambat" 
FROM analytics.attendance_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND late_days > 0 GROUP BY CASE lateness_bucket WHEN '<1' THEN '01 · <1 menit' WHEN '1-15' THEN '02 · 1–15 menit' WHEN '16-30' THEN '03 · 16–30 menit' WHEN '31-60' THEN '04 · 31–60 menit' WHEN '>60' THEN '05 · >60 menit' END ORDER BY "Pegawai-hari terlambat" DESC 
 LIMIT 100;

Sort Key: (sum(CASE WHEN (f.is_expected_workday AND ((f.status_kehadiran)::text = 'HADIR'::text) AND (f.menit_terlambat IS NOT NULL) AND f.is_terlambat) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC

Group Key: (CASE CASE WHEN ((NOT f.is_terlambat) OR (f.menit_terlambat IS NULL)) THEN NULL::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat < 1) THEN '<1'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 15) THEN '1-15'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 30) THEN '16-30'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 60) THEN '31-60'::text ELSE '>60'::text END WHEN '<1'::text THEN '01 · <1 menit'::text WHEN '1-15'::text THEN '02 · 1–15 menit'::text WHEN '16-30'::text THEN '03 · 16–30 menit'::text WHEN '31-60'::text THEN '04 · 31–60 menit'::text WHEN '>60'::text THEN '05 · >60 menit'::text ELSE NULL::text END)

Sort Key: (CASE CASE WHEN ((NOT f.is_terlambat) OR (f.menit_terlambat IS NULL)) THEN NULL::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat < 1) THEN '<1'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 15) THEN '1-15'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 30) THEN '16-30'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 60) THEN '31-60'::text ELSE '>60'::text END WHEN '<1'::text THEN '01 · <1 menit'::text WHEN '1-15'::text THEN '02 · 1–15 menit'::text WHEN '16-30'::text THEN '03 · 16–30 menit'::text WHEN '31-60'::text THEN '04 · 31–60 menit'::text WHEN '>60'::text THEN '05 · >60 menit'::text ELSE NULL::text END)

Group Key: CASE CASE WHEN ((NOT f.is_terlambat) OR (f.menit_terlambat IS NULL)) THEN NULL::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat < 1) THEN '<1'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 15) THEN '1-15'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 30) THEN '16-30'::text WHEN (f.menit_terlambat <= 60) THEN '31-60'::text ELSE '>60'::text END WHEN '<1'::text THEN '01 · <1 menit'::text WHEN '1-15'::text THEN '02 · 1–15 menit'::text WHEN '16-30'::text THEN '03 · 16–30 menit'::text WHEN '31-60'::text THEN '04 · 31–60 menit'::text WHEN '>60'::text THEN '05 · >60 menit'::text ELSE NULL::text END

queryComparisons.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(absent_days) / NULLIF(SUM(expected_days), 0) AS absence_rate 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', tanggal) AS tanggal, 1.0 * SUM(late_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(late_days), 0) AS average_lateness 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', tanggal) ORDER BY average_lateness DESC 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(late_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(late_days), 0) AS average_lateness 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', tanggal) AS tanggal, 100.0 * SUM(absent_days) / NULLIF(SUM(expected_days), 0) AS absence_rate 
FROM analytics.attendance_department_daily 
WHERE tanggal >= TO_DATE('2026-08-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tanggal < TO_DATE('2026-09-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', tanggal) ORDER BY absence_rate DESC 
 LIMIT 10000;
